lines.en: scene girlsshoppingwoo1
Life moves on without you.
lines.zh: 生活没有你也照样继续。

lines.en: In an outlet park not far from where you lay your head at night, four girls engage in a ruthless battle known as “Christmas shopping.”
lines.zh: 在离你每晚安睡之处不远的一座奥特莱斯，四个女孩正在进行一场名为「圣诞采购」的残酷战斗。

lines.en: Rumors say that such a thing used to be dangerous in the past. But here in the new world, where everyone either shops online or dies in space, shopping centers aren’t as busy as they used to be.
lines.zh: 传闻说这种事在过去曾经很危险。但在这个新世界里——人人都上网购物，或者死在太空里——购物中心已经不像从前那么拥挤了。

lines.en: Regardless, the members of this ragtag group of unlikely friends fill their arms with material goods, excited to wrap them up and drop them off when the sun crawls back into its hole beneath the earth later on.
lines.zh: 尽管如此，这支由八竿子打不着的朋友组成的杂牌军，怀里还是塞满了物质商品，兴高采烈地要把它们包好，等太阳爬回地底下的洞里时送出去。

lines.en: There is one girl without anything in her arms though — and it is not just because her breasts are so large that they render her incapable of holding anything in front of her.
lines.zh: 不过有个女孩怀里什么都没有——而这并不仅仅因为她的胸部大到让她没法在身前抱住任何东西。

lines.en: It’s because, beneath the facade she dons to mask her flaws, she is cracking. And she can’t seem to find the motivation that has always come to her so easily.
lines.zh: 而是因为，在她用来掩饰自身缺陷的那层面具之下，她正在龟裂。而她似乎找不到那份向来轻而易举就会涌上来的动力。

lines.en: Could this be love? Or is it just a passing virus? A tiny seed inside her mind that will one day bloom into a beautiful aneurysm that will pop and swiftly end her life.
lines.zh: 这会是爱吗？还是只是一种过路的病毒？一颗埋在她脑海里的细小种子，有朝一日会绽放成一朵美丽的动脉瘤，然后啪的一声，利落地结束她的生命。

lines.en: “I’ll buy something later,” she thinks. “I already have everything,” she reaffirms. But then, without saying a word, she reverts back to scarier thoughts.
lines.zh: 「我待会儿再买吧，」她想。「我什么都有了，」她再次确认。可接着，她一言不发地又回到了那些更可怕的念头上。

lines.en: “I hope he is okay.”
lines.zh: 「我希望他没事。」

lines.en: “What was the last thing I even said to him?”
lines.zh: 「我最后到底跟他说了什么？」

lines.en: “Maybe I could just buy him off of Ami?”
lines.zh: 「也许我可以直接把他从 Ami 手里买过来？」

lines.en: That last one lacks authenticity, but I’m sure you understand the sentiment by now. Because {i}everyone{/i} understands the sentiment by now.
lines.zh: 最后那句不够真诚，不过我相信你现在已经明白这份心情了。因为现在{i}每个人{/i}都明白这份心情。

lines.en: Just some elect to keep it to themselves-
lines.zh: 只是有些人选择把它藏在心里——

lines.en: : So...um...will Sensei be at this year’s Christmas party?
lines.zh: : 那个……嗯……Sensei 会来今年的圣诞派对吗？

lines.en: And some would rather share it.
lines.zh: 而有些人宁愿说出口。

lines.en: : It will be quite the surprise if he is. But I’m certain none of us are banking on such a thing at the moment.
lines.zh: : 如果他能来，那可真是个大惊喜。不过我确信眼下我们谁都没有把希望押在这上面。

lines.en: : From what I understand, Sensei is still...going through a bit of a rough patch right now. And there is naught for us to do but wait until he is open to seeing us again.
lines.zh: : 据我所知，Sensei 现在还在……经历一段比较艰难的时期。而我们除了等他愿意重新见我们之外，别无他法。

lines.en: : Is that why you haven’t bought anything yet? You drew Sensei’s name for Secret Santa this year and you’re worried you might have to hold onto your present for the rest of forever?
lines.zh: : 所以你才什么都还没买吗？你今年抽到了 Sensei 的秘密圣诞老人，担心这份礼物可能得永远攥在手里？

lines.en: scene girlsshoppingwoo2
: As apt as it would be for me to draw his name two years in a row, I regret to inform you that is not the case this time.
lines.zh: : 虽然连续两年抽到他的名字确实很符合我的风格，但很遗憾，这次并非如此。

lines.en: : So...he’s still feeling sick? Or...or depressed or...whatever it is he’s going through right now?
lines.zh: : 那……他还是不舒服？或者……或者是抑郁，或者……他现在正在经历的那些什么的？

lines.en: : It certainly appears that way, Karin. But conversing about it won’t bring him back any sooner and I think we would be better off discussing {i}other{/i} matters for now.
lines.zh: : 看起来确实如此，Karin。但聊这些不会让他早一天回来，我觉得我们现在还是聊聊{i}别的{/i}事比较好。

lines.en: scene girlsshoppingwoo3
: You know what {i}would{/i} bring him back sooner? Heading over there right now and busting him out ourselves. It’s not like Ami can hold back all four of us, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道什么才能让他早点回来吗？现在就冲过去，我们自己把他劫出来。Ami 又挡不住我们四个人，对吧？

lines.en: : Kirin, I think this is one of those situations where we shouldn’t try to get involved. Let’s just focus on getting ready for the party tonight and-
lines.zh: : Kirin，我觉得这种情况我们不该掺和。我们还是专心准备今晚的派对——

lines.en: : And kidnapping an adult male. On it, sis.
lines.zh: : 还有绑架一名成年男性。明白了，姐。

lines.en: : That is not a good idea.
lines.zh: : 那不是个好主意。

lines.en: scene girlsshoppingwoo4
: And why is that, Yasu?
lines.zh: : 为什么这么说，Yasu？

lines.en: scene girlsshoppingwoo5
: Because it is not our place to interfere.
lines.zh: : 因为不该由我们来干涉。

lines.en: : We are the cherubs who move the curtains — and the more important jobs are left for the more important people.
lines.zh: : 我们只是负责拉动帷幕的小天使——更重要的差事，留给更重要的人。

lines.en: : My, you might be the first person I’ve ever encountered who has blatantly ignored just how important I actually am. Apart from our missing teacher, that is.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，你可能是我遇到的第一个公然无视我到底有多重要的人。除了我们那位失踪的老师之外。

lines.en: : Bad things will happen if we stray from the path we’re walking now.
lines.zh: : 如果我们偏离此刻所走的路，就会有坏事发生。

lines.en: : The insects sing their carols in tune with the growth of posies — and in their lyrics, I have once more caught the future.
lines.zh: : 昆虫随着花丛的生长唱着颂歌——而在它们的歌词里，我再一次捕捉到了未来。

lines.en: : But it is an uncertain one. And dotted with so many asterisks that my eyes burn just thinking of the possibilities.
lines.zh: : 但那是个不确定的未来。星号密密麻麻，光是想想那些可能性，我的眼睛就发烫。

lines.en: : English, please?
lines.zh: : 请说人话好吗？

lines.en: : You speak English? Since when?
lines.zh: : 你会说英语？从什么时候开始的？

lines.en: : In simpler terms, we would break him.
lines.zh: : 说简单点，我们会把他弄坏。

lines.en: scene girlsshoppingwoo6
: {i}Break{/i} him? Now, how would we do that?
lines.zh: : 弄坏他？我们怎么会弄坏他？

lines.en: : It is less “we” and more “you,” Touka.
lines.zh: : 与其说是「我们」，不如说是「你」，Touka。

lines.en: scene girlsshoppingwoo7
: Me?! But I’m the responsible one!
lines.zh: : 我？！可我才是那个靠谱的人啊！

lines.en: : Hey!
: You are. And I can’t imagine returning to a life without you in it. But your judgement is clouded right now- and you’d subject yourself to tortures and torment you would otherwise subvert.
lines.zh: : 你确实是。而我无法想象回到一个没有你的生活里。可此刻你的判断力蒙上了阴影——你会让自己承受那些本可以避开的折磨与痛苦。

lines.en: scene girlsshoppingwoo8
: Cool. So Touka stays here and the rest of us go kidnap Sensei. Karin’s more than enough to overpower Ami. I’m sure we’ll be fine.
lines.zh: : 酷。那就 Touka 留在这儿，我们其余的去绑架 Sensei。Karin 一个人压倒 Ami 绰绰有余。我确信我们不会有事。

lines.en: : I don’t want to {i}overpower{/i} anyone! I just wanted to know if he was coming to the Christmas party! I’m not nearly as impatient as the rest of you!
lines.zh: : 我才不想{i}压倒{/i}谁！我只是想知道他会不会来圣诞派对！我可没有你们其他人那么不耐烦！

lines.en: : For what it’s worth, Kirin seems to be the only visibly impatient member of this group at the moment.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，眼下 Kirin 似乎是这群人里唯一明显不耐烦的那个。

lines.en: scene girlsshoppingwoo9
: For real! Even {i}Noriko’s{/i} been weirdly calm about this whole situation and it’s making me question my sanity for thinking about it so much.
lines.zh: : 真的！连 {i}Noriko{/i} 对整件事都异常冷静，这让我开始怀疑自己想这么多是不是脑子有问题。

lines.en: : But, then again, she’s already dealt with this once before for a {i}much{/i} longer amount of time. So right now, she’s probably just happy she knows where he is.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，她以前已经经历过一次，而且时间要长得多。所以现在，她大概只是庆幸自己知道他在哪儿。

lines.en: : Um...correct me if I’m wrong, but...weren’t we supposed to be moving onto other topics that {i}aren’t{/i} about Sensei?
lines.zh: : 嗯……要是我说错了请纠正，不过……我们不是该聊点跟 Sensei 无关的话题了吗？

lines.en: scene girlsshoppingwoo10
: Oh, yeah. I guess we were.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。我想是的。

lines.en: : See, this is exactly what I meant just now when I said I’ve been questioning my sanity. Like, why is Sensei the only thing I’m thinking about lately? It’s weird.
lines.zh: : 你看，这正是我刚才说自己开始怀疑精神状态的意思。比如，为什么我最近满脑子只有 Sensei？太奇怪了。

lines.en: : I...might have an idea why...
lines.zh: : 我……大概知道为什么……

lines.en: : Wasting thoughts on entities other than God is the easiest sin to commit, but that doesn’t mean it’s easy to forgive!
lines.zh: : 把心思浪费在神以外的存在上，是最容易犯下的罪，但这并不代表它容易被赦免！

lines.en: scene girlsshoppingwoo11
: Spare no dream, nor hopes or prayers, for anyone but He who cares! Penemue taught me that rhyme in exchange for an extra cup of tea. Isn’t it lovely?
lines.zh: : 别把梦想、希望和祈祷留给任何人，只留给那位在意你的祂！Penemue 用多给我一杯茶作交换，教会了我这首小诗。很美吧？

lines.en: : Penemue?
lines.zh: : Penemue？

lines.en: : The name of the rabbit matters only half as much as the direction its ears rest in! Follow them up instead of down! And erase those troubled thoughts from your mind before you face ruin!
lines.zh: : 兔子的名字，重要性只有它耳朵朝向的一半那么重要！跟着耳朵朝上走，别朝下！在你走向毁灭之前，把那些烦忧的念头从脑子里抹掉！

lines.en: : Touka, I think your pet is broken again.
lines.zh: : Touka，我觉得你的宠物又坏掉了。

lines.en: : To be frank, I’m not quite sure she can be fixed. But her ramblings, fanatical as they may be, have yet to lead me astray. And I’ve found it’s normally best to trust her when she says {i}not{/i} to do something.
lines.zh: : 坦白说，我不太确定她还能不能修好。可她那些胡言乱语，不管多狂热，至今还没把我带偏过。而且我发现，当她说{i}不要{/i}做某件事时，通常最好还是听她的。

lines.en: : Well, I’m not about to go storm his house all by myself, so I guess we can just keep shopping for now.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我也不打算一个人去冲他家，那我想我们还是继续逛街吧。

lines.en: : I just wish we could have gone to the mall. Like, who starts renovations right before the holiday season? Isn’t that weird?
lines.zh: : 我只是希望我们能去商场。话说，谁会在节假日前夕开始装修啊？不觉得奇怪吗？

lines.en: : Perhaps it was a safety issue? I’ve never needed to rely on a “mall” in the first place, so I’m likely a bit out-of-touch with the ways in which they typically operate.
lines.zh: : 也许是安全问题？我本来就从来不需要依赖什么「商场」，所以我对它们通常的运营方式大概有点脱节。

lines.en: : For what it’s worth, at least you don’t look as lost as that woman over there.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，至少你看上去没有那边那位女士那么迷茫。

lines.en: scene girlsshoppingwoo12
: Aaaah! Haru-chan, I forgot how dangerous it is for me to go shopping now that I actually have money! Why aren’t you stopping me?!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！Haru-chan，我都忘了我现在真有钱了，逛街有多危险！你为什么不拦着我？！

lines.en: : Because every time I’ve tried, you’ve sprinted across the store and pretended you didn’t hear me.
lines.zh: : 因为每次我试着拦，你都会冲过整个店，假装没听见。

lines.en: scene girlsshoppingwoo13
: Then chase after me!
lines.zh: : 那就来追我啊！

lines.en: : With {i}these{/i} boobs and your...youthful vigor? Yeah, I’m good. You’re just going to have to learn to be a little more responsible.
lines.zh: : 就凭我这副胸，还有你那股……青春活力？算了吧。你还是得学着负责任一点。

lines.en: scene girlsshoppingwoo14
: Ugh...but it’s so hard when I don’t even know what I’m shopping {i}for.{/i} I feel like I’ve told Sensei a million things about myself, but I don’t know the first thing about what {i}he{/i} likes.
lines.zh: : 呃……可我连自己在买什么都不知道，这太难了。我感觉自己已经跟 Sensei 说过一百万件关于我的事，可我一点都不知道他喜欢什么。

lines.en: : Boobs. And teenagers.
lines.zh: : 胸。还有十几岁的女孩。

lines.en: scene girlsshoppingwoo15
: I can’t buy him “boobs and teenagers,” Haru-chan!
lines.zh: : 我没法给他买「胸和十几岁的女孩」啊，Haru-chan！

lines.en: : Sure you can. We live in Japan. And our friend literally owns a porn shop.
lines.zh: : 你当然能。我们住在日本。而且我们的朋友真的开了一家色情用品店。

lines.en: : No, I meant I can’t buy him those things for Christmas! I need to get him an {i}actual{/i} present so he’ll remember how much I care about him and stop avoiding me!
lines.zh: : 不是，我的意思是我不能把这些当圣诞礼物送他！我得给他买一件{i}真正{/i}的礼物，好让他记得我有多在乎他，然后别再躲着我！

lines.en: : Sara, you know he’s avoiding literally {i}everyone,{/i} right? This isn’t some targeted effort to make you feel insignificant or something.
lines.zh: : Sara，你知道他在躲的是所有人，对吧？这不是专门为了让你觉得自己无足轻重什么的。

lines.en: scene girlsshoppingwoo16

: Hah...I know. I know, I know, I know. This just isn’t a situation I have any idea how to handle. It’s nothing like when you or Maki get depressed. Like, this is a guy I didn’t even know {i}had{/i} feelings until recently.
lines.zh: : 哈……我知道。我知道，我知道，我知道。只是这种情况我完全不知道该怎么处理。这跟你或 Maki 消沉的时候完全不一样。比如，我直到最近才知道这个男人居然还{i}有{/i}感情。

lines.en: if saraspecial30p2 == True:
: And now that I’m starting to understand more about what those feelings {i}are,{/i} it’s making everything a hell of a lot more complicated.
lines.zh: : 而现在我渐渐开始明白那些感情是什么，这让一切都变得更加复杂得要命。

lines.en: : Well, what do you mean by “what those feelings are?” Because I’m still pretty sure something as simple as “love” is off the table for him. At least for now.
lines.zh: : 嗯，「那些感情是什么」是什么意思？因为我还是挺确定，像「爱」这么简单的东西，对他来说暂时是不可能的。至少现在是。

lines.en: scene girlsshoppingwoo17
: If there was a way for me to answer that question without sounding like a complete psychopath, I would.
lines.zh: : 如果能有办法在回答这个问题时不听起来像个彻头彻尾的精神病，我早就回答了。

lines.en: : Sara, I have known you long enough at this point to confidently tell you that there is absolutely {i}nothing{/i} you could say to me that would change how I already think you’re a psychopath.
lines.zh: : Sara，我认识你这么久了，可以很自信地告诉你：你说什么都不会改变我{i}你就是个精神病{/i}这个既有判断。

lines.en: : Thanks, Haru-chan. That means a-
lines.zh: : 谢了，Haru-chan。这对我意——

lines.en: scene girlsshoppingwoo18
: Wait a minute. That’s not how you were supposed to respond to that.
lines.zh: : 等等。你本不该这么回应的。

lines.en: : Wow, this weather sure is great!
lines.zh: : 哇，今天天气真好啊！

lines.en: : Yeah. Real {i}great.{/i}
lines.zh: : 是啊。真他妈{i}好{/i}。

lines.en: scene girlsshoppingwoo19

: Sara, listen. I’m sure that whatever you get for Sensei will be totally fine. Like, if anything, I think the fact that he’s completely devoid of...basically {i}any{/i} interests could be a {i}good{/i} thing.
lines.zh: : Sara，听着。我相信你给 Sensei 买什么都没问题。要说的话，我觉得他基本上对什么都毫无兴趣，这反而可能是件好事。

lines.en: : It sure beats him actively {i}disliking{/i} everything, doesn’t it? Just assume that whatever you get for him will get, like...a neutral reaction or something like that. Boom, Christmas is saved.
lines.zh: : 总比他积极讨厌一切要强，不是吗？就假设你买什么他都只会给个中性反应之类的。砰，圣诞节得救了。

lines.en: : No, it’s not saved at all! I want to get him something special. Something that makes him {i}want{/i} to see me again because {i}I{/i} want to be the person he comes to when he’s breaking.
lines.zh: : 不，一点都没得救！我想给他买点特别的东西。一件能让他想再见我的东西，因为我想成为他崩溃时会来找的那个人。

lines.en: scene girlsshoppingwoo20
: This whole month has been hell. I was able to make it through November just fine because, after the father of your kids walks out on you, you learn a thing or two about being forced to let go.
lines.zh: : 这一整个月简直是地狱。11 月我还能熬过来，因为在你孩子的父亲甩手走人之后，你多少会学到一点关于被迫放手的东西。

lines.en: : But the difference {i}this{/i} time is that A) I don’t {i}technically{/i} have anything to let go {i}of.{/i} And B) I know he’s still {i}here.{/i}
lines.zh: : 但这一次的不同在于：A）严格来说我并没有什么可以放手的。B）我知道他还在这儿。

lines.en: : He didn’t skip town or hop on a plane headed for some foreign country. He’s at {i}home.{/i} He’s so close by and I can’t even {i}talk{/i} to him. I can’t do anything.
lines.zh: : 他没有跑路，也没有跳上飞往外国的飞机。他在{i}家{/i}。他离我那么近，我连跟他说句{i}话{/i}都做不到。我什么都做不了。

lines.en: : Sara...it’s not your role to do anything. You’re not his mom, you’re his friend. And he’ll call on you if he needs you.
lines.zh: : Sara……本来就不该由你来做点什么。你不是他妈妈，你是他朋友。他需要你的时候自然会来找你。

lines.en: : No he won’t. Have you {i}talked{/i} to him before? He’d never ask for help with anything.
lines.zh: : 他不会的。你以前跟他聊过吗？他从来不会为任何事求助。

lines.en: : Plus, even if I’m not {i}his{/i} mom, I am {i}a{/i} mom. And this is starting to feel a lot like how it felt with Sana when...
lines.zh: : 再说，就算我不是他妈妈，我也是个母亲。而这开始变得很像当初对 Sana 的那种感觉，当……

lines.en: : When...yeah. Because back then, I was fucked up too. And I was in no condition to help her since I was still figuring things out for myself. But this is different.
lines.zh: : 当……是啊。因为那个时候我自己也一团糟。我自己都还在摸索，根本没状态帮她。但这次不一样。

lines.en: scene girlsshoppingwoo21
: I’m okay now. Or...or mostly okay, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我现在没事了。或者……大概基本没事了吧。

lines.en: : There are good days and there are bad days.
lines.zh: : 有好的日子，也有坏的日子。

lines.en: : I just don’t want someone else I care about to have to face their biggest battles without help. And even if he’s got Ami there for him, that’s...
lines.zh: : 我只是不想再让我在乎的人独自面对他最大的战役。就算他身边有 Ami，那也……

lines.en: : It’s not me.
lines.zh: : 那不是我。

lines.en: : I know that might sound selfish. And I know he probably doesn’t {i}need{/i} me. But honestly, neither does Sana. And having {i}no one{/i} who needs me fucking {i}sucks{/i} when all I want is to be there.
lines.zh: : 我知道这听起来可能很自私。我也知道他大概不需要我。可说实话，Sana 也不需要我。而在我只想陪在身边的时候，没有任何人需要我，这他妈糟透了。

lines.en: : I hear that...and I totally get you. But, at the same time, I don’t think you need to empty out your entire bank account buying every single thing you see for the guy.
lines.zh: : 我听到了……我完全懂你。但与此同时，我觉得你也没必要为了给那家伙买下看到的每一样东西而把银行账户掏空。

lines.en: scene girlsshoppingwoo22
: Oh, half of these are for me.
lines.zh: : 哦，这些有一半是给我自己的。

lines.en: : Wait, really?
lines.zh: : 等等，真的？

lines.en: : Maybe more than half.
lines.zh: : 也许不止一半。

lines.en: : Maybe all of them.
lines.zh: : 也许全是。

lines.en: : Wasn’t the whole point of this trip going out so we could get something for {i}him?{/i}
lines.zh: : 我们这趟出门的意义，不就是给{i}他{/i}买点什么吗？

lines.en: : Yeah but, like I said, he’s hard to shop for.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可就像我说的，给他买东西太难了。

lines.en: : So your solution is to just...shop for yourself instead?
lines.zh: : 所以你的解决办法就是……干脆给自己买？

lines.en: : It helps calm me down.
lines.zh: : 这能让我冷静下来。

lines.en: : Sara, you’ve been standing there with your head in your hands for about ten minutes now. And I’m pretty sure you let out an obnoxiously loud scream after we left that store.
lines.zh: : Sara，你已经双手抱头在那儿站了大概十分钟了。而且我很确定我们离开那家店的时候，你发出了震耳欲聋的一声尖叫。

lines.en: : Screaming helps calm me down too.
lines.zh: : 尖叫也能让我冷静下来。

lines.en: : You have a problem.
lines.zh: : 你有问题。

lines.en: : I swear I only had like, two glasses of wine this morning.
lines.zh: : 我发誓我今天早上只喝了两杯葡萄酒。

lines.en: : Oh, you meant shopping.
lines.zh: : 哦，你说的是购物。

lines.en: : You had two glasses of wine? It’s not even 11:00 AM yet.
lines.zh: : 你喝了两杯葡萄酒？现在还不到上午 11 点呢。

lines.en: : Maybe three.
lines.zh: : 也许三杯。

lines.en: : Maybe four.
lines.zh: : 也许四杯。

lines.en: : Maybe the whole bottle.
lines.zh: : 也许一整瓶。

lines.en: scene girlsshoppingwoo23
: But that doesn’t change the fact that I need to find Sensei a present before all the shops on this street shut their doors! Quick, Haru-chan! To the manliest store we can find! For manly things!
lines.zh: : 可这改变不了事实——我得在这条街上的店都关门之前给 Sensei 找到一件礼物！快，Haru-chan！去我们能找到的最有男人味的店！买有男人味的东西！

lines.en: : Or...anywhere else that looks interesting along the way!
lines.zh: : 或者……路上任何看起来有意思的地方！

lines.en: : Why couldn’t you just get him something online like a normal millenial?
lines.zh: : 你为什么不能像个正常的千禧一代一样，在网上给他买点什么呢？

lines.en: scene black
: Ahhh! You and Sana both! You guys just don’t get it! All the fun in Christmas shopping is going out and actually {i}doing{/i} it!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！你和 Sana 都一样！你们根本不懂！圣诞采购的乐趣就在于出门去真的{i}做{/i}这件事！

lines.en: : Where {i}is{/i} Sana anyway?
lines.zh: : Sana {i}到底{/i}去哪儿了？

lines.en: : Beats me. She said she was busy this morning.
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢。她说她今天早上很忙。
